what_to_detect: A permanent with amplify enters the battlefield with +1/+1 counters, amplify's number of them per card sharing a creature type with it revealed from hand.
near_miss: A permanent with amplify entering with no counters because no card was revealed.
record_fields: resolution payload events counter_change (counter_type, delta) on the entering permanent
zone_change to battlefield in the same effect half
the keyword's sidecar line (Keyword API type, keyword plus replacement keys)
rewrite record on the zone_change to battlefield, replaced_by the keyword's replacement
